fields.Name: T108 - Home Quick Action Pins
fields.Description: Verifies that the Quick Action Pins / pinned items area on the Home landing dashboard renders correctly, showing pinned items or a valid empty/add-pin state without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to the Home app landing dashboard (route /app/home) - use the Home icon/logo or the application switcher dropdown next to the logo if needed (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). On the Home landing page, locate the Quick Action Pins / pinned items area. The success state is that the Quick Action Pins area renders: it shows pinned dashboards/views/queries, OR a valid empty-state inviting the user to add a pin. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait for the landing page widgets to finish rendering, do not navigate away early.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Home app landing dashboard is loaded (route /app/home)
The Quick Action Pins / pinned items area is visible and rendered - showing pinned items, or a valid empty/add-pin state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
